name: Destruction in Deadmines
summary: Destruction in Deadmines is a covert sabotage mission coordinated by Alba Fairmoon to strike at the heart of the Defias Brotherhood's industrial operations. Deep within the labyrinthine tunnels beneath Moonbrook, the Brotherhood runs a massive metallurgical forge suspected of poisoning the surrounding land. Adventurers are tasked with penetrating the complex, planting powerful explosives near the foundry, and crippling the brotherhood's war effort.

sections.title: Sabotaging the Foundry
sections.body: The Deadmines hold more than just gold veins and cutpurses; beneath the dusty surface of Moonbrook lies a fortified industrial complex fueling the Defias Brotherhood. Among their underground works is a heavy metallurgical forge used to smelt metals and assemble machinery. Alba Fairmoon identifies this forge as the likely origin of environmental contamination blighting the area, making its demolition a vital goal.

sections.title: A Decisive Blast
sections.body: Reaching the heart of the Deadmines requires fighting through barricades, cutthroats, and goblin engineers. Armed with Extra-Destructive Explosives, an operative must plant the charge directly beside the forge works and make a hasty escape to the hills above Moonbrook, where Fairmoon waits to trigger the blast and permanently disable the brotherhood's manufacturing capability.

faq.q: What is the goal of this mission?
faq.answer: The objective is to infiltrate the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, locate the Defias Brotherhood's metallurgical forge, and plant Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby before rendezvous with Alba Fairmoon at the exit.
Alba Fairmoon is an Alliance operative working in Westfall who believes the blight and poison corrupting the region stem from heavy smelting and industrial operations inside the Deadmines.

faq.q: Why is the Defias forge considered so dangerous?
faq.answer: Beyond producing weapons and machinery for Edwin VanCleef's brotherhood, the metallurgical forge discharges toxic waste and fumes that poison the surrounding soil and water of Westfall.

faq.q: Where does the player meet Alba after planting the explosives?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon waits outside the Deadmines complex in the hills behind Moonbrook near the mine's upper exit, ready to trigger the demolition once the operative safely emerges.

faq.q: Where is the forge located inside the Deadmines?
faq.answer: The forge is located deep inside the Deadmines instance, past the mining tunnels and within the industrial foundry sections manned by Defias laborers and goblin overseers.

faq.q: Does destroying the forge heal the land immediately?
faq.answer: Alba hopes that eliminating the heavy smelting operations will allow the land around Moonbrook to finally recover, though years of Defias industry and neglect will take time to wash away.

angles.text: Using specialized Extra-Destructive Explosives against heavy industrial infrastructure requires precise placement near key structural stress points to ensure total destruction of the forge.
The Deadmines were once Stormwind's most lucrative gold and iron mines, now perverted by the Defias into a fortified smelting complex that blights the earth.
Crippling the Defias forge strikes directly at the machinery and weaponry threatening Stormwind's sovereignty from within Westfall.
